summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary OPC Energy Ltd. received tariff approval from the Israeli Electricity Authority for the Hadera power plant expansion project. The approval sets an availability tariff of 3.31 agorot for approximately 25 years from commercial operation and confirms conditions for financial closing. No corporate action, acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; it is a routine operational update regarding a regulatory milestone for a power plant project.
